newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index down slightly.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index down slightly.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was off 1.12 points or 1.66 percent at 66.52 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index fell 62.30 points or 2.11 percent to end at a provisional 2886.14.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 17.07 percent after 16.22 percent on Tuesday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
